text: Axar Xyrl was a morkoth and an arcount of the Arcanum of Olleth in Serôs in 1370 DR.
Azla was a half-elf Cormyrean pirate in the mid-14 century DR, who sailed about in her caravel, the Black Champion.
Ba Salnang was the owner of the Fountain of Happiness Inn in Manass in 1367 DR.
Baerzlus Anagathiir was the only Red Wizard of Thay to become a Magister. He was known for one of the shortest reigns ever.
Bahooha Shortleeves was the traveling companion of Bistro Battenrooj in Impiltur in 1359 DR.
Baelam the Bold was a wizard and thief in Myth Drannor in the .
Baedelkar the Thaumaturge was a Zhentarim wizard in Ordulin.
Bajangs () were a race of evil, intelligent lesser spirits or fey native to Kara-Tur.

Baerovus Azoun Obaskyr , more commonly known as Prince Baerovus, was a Crown Prince of Cormyr and son of King Irvel. On Nightal 5 of 1486 DR he abdicated the throne in favor of his sister Princess Raedra after the death of his father on Uktar 14 and grandfather on Eleint 5 of the same year.
Ayala was a wood elf warrior who lived in Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.
Baelaetha Baergil (? – 1337 DR) was a farmer's wife who lived near to Ashabenford, Mistledale. She was the mother of famous Captain Darrask Baergil of the Riders of Mistledale.

Baiyen Chergova was the head of the refectory of the Thayan enclave within the city of Proskur as well as its head provisioner, around 1372 DR. He was employed by the Guild of Foreign Trade, serving as a mid-ranking employee therein.
Ba'sula Baenre was a young member of House Baenre in 1486 DR.

Azar Valsheem was a sous chef who lived in Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR. Along with Chenna Fatrabbit and Klav Martilmur, they worked at the Elfsong Tavern, preparing food from midday until midnight. Azar was known as being rather ill-tempered.

Baerzel was one of the three war-leaders of the tribe of orcs known as the Tornskulls that dwelled within Dead Orc Pass. Despite her leadership role, she had no want to rule over the tribe nor manipulate or guide any future chiefs.
Bahija bint Tufala was a Zakharan Sa'luk living in Hiyal in Zakhara around 1367 DR.
Avery Arrinson was a proxy of Fenmarel Mestarine on Fennimar in Limbo.
Axxium Korvis was a shaman of Tempus at the Hall of Warriors in 1358 DR.
Azetlin was the kobold scribe of a tribe from Undermountain that raided streets of Waterdeep mid–14 century DR.
Bahija min Selan was a pragmatist and a member of the royal court of Rog'osto's khedive, Samia al-Sa'id, in 1367 DR.
Azunt Haelcloak was a herbalist of the city of Arabel in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR and a noted supporter of the Lost King Gondegal in his uprising of the .

Bael ( ) was an archdevil duke of the Nine Hells who served the Lord of the Third, Mammon. He was one of Hell's greatest tacticians, named the Bronze General for the hue of his skin and various military accomplishments, but he was impeded in his ascendance to the rank of archduke by his lack of political prowess.
Baelrath the Vile was a pit fiend that was summoned to Faerûn by the Ashmadai during the late 15 century DR.
Ayriisha was a paladin of Corellon that lived in the city of Neverwinter during the late 15 century DR.
Badr Al-Mosak was an evil ruler who stole the Star of Shah-Pelar and had it buried with him upon his death.
Baerimel Dunnath was a wizard in Thentia in and in . She was deputy of Sureene Aumratha, of the House of the Moon.
Ayanna Orgolath was a human lover of the demon lord Graz'zt whose affections would eventually birth the Orgolath Dynasty of Nentyarch rulers in Narfell.
Avel was Josef Darag's son. On Mirtul 19 of the , he was part of the force riding with his father, which was retreating back to the Duchy of Springhill. He was the one carrying the standard.
Azkhazan was a mage who lived in Calimport some time before the late 14 century DR.
Avery Sonshal was a pyrotechnics merchant that lived in Baldur's Gate.
Baelen Bonecloak was a shopkeep from Baldur's Gate and the co-proprietor of the shop that bore his family's name, along with his wife Derryth as of the late 15 century DR.
Backes Dunfield was the bartender of the Wayside Inn in the late 15th century DR. He was secretly a member of a Talos cult.

Big Chief Bagoomba was the leader of the Tribe of Big Chief Bagoomba, formerly the Saiyama tribe, that dwelt at the base of the Fire Mountain on the Malatran Plateau, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Baernoth was a turnip farmer and the Elder of the village of Maskyr's Eye in the Vast in the mid–14 century DR.
Baerhar Surtlan was a shopkeeper inhabiting the city of Waterdeep in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Axalt was a Revered Counselor of Nexal who ruled over the empire in its most prosperous era in the early-to-mid–14 century DR.
Baerbuckle Klaeverdar was a member of the Klaeverdar clan in the late 14 century DR.
Aventgar Pureblade was an adventuring paladin from the Jumpa River Gorge, active in the 14 century DR.
Aznee Fraystrings was an infamous ill-fated traveling minstrel who spent his final days in the village of Hornhollow, long before the early 14 century DR.
Avbrauve Haltorel was a retired warrior and fishmonger inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Azoulin Wolfwind was a stationer inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Baalbaas Partall was a grocer inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid–1360's DR.
Baerlos Dunthar was a joiner inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid–to-late 14 century DR.
Azreena Ironoath was a human priest of Torm who oversaw the House of Duty in Halfhap in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lord Baerom Thunderstaff II was a Tethyrian noble and practitioner of magic inhabiting Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Tracker Bal was a servant of the Absolute who dwelled within the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Tracker Azak was a goblin devotee of the Absolute who dwelled within the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Azahr was a dancer and the ringleader of a bardic group of traveling scoundrels in the late 14 century DR.
Azatlim was a warrior in service to Lord Tessaril Winter in Eveningstar, Cormyr, in the mid–14 century DR.
Dame Aylin was an aasimar and the daughter of the goddess Selûne, who was imprisoned within the Shadowfell by General Ketheric Thorm in the 14 and 15 centuries DR.
Baelen Anastur was an elderly gnome businessman who owned and operated Anastur's Abrasives of Llorkh during the 15 century DR.
Babylas was a Netherese cleric who co-owned and operated House Implement Wholesalers alongside Clement and Cogan in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Ba'akreth was a githyanki youth from Crèche Y'llek, on Toril during the late 15 century DR.
Baff Elkhorn was an unsavory barbarian gnome merc from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Avgarioletta was a Dark Breaker of Umberlee, a member of the Bitch Queen's clergy under Flood Tide Allandra Grey of the Water Queen's House in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Avrixis Mizzrym was a drow ranger member of House Mizzrym who sought to fulfill her ambitions in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Baerold was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Bailey was one of the employees of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Baalfe was a hireling guard who worked for Baldur's Mouth in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Ayo Armbrust was the son of Talli and Tym Armbrust, a down-on-his-luck tailor, from Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Baerdagh was a former warrior living in Ripplestones during the mid–8 century DR.
Baerimgrim was a king of Galadorna during the mid–8 century DR.
Avroana was a Sharran high priestess at the House of Holy Night in the mid–8 century DR.
Babyjowls was a member of the Guild from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bagdog was a Fist of Bane who served the Cult of the Absolute in the late 15 century DR.
Avro Quarrel was a human resident of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Baerann Kordeemur was a famous composer of Mulhessen, considered to be the most prestigious tunesmith of Sembia by some in the 15 century DR.
Azazabus was a wizard and evil overlord in the Dalelands at some point prior to the 14 century DR.

Badmuddin the Bald was a brigand from the Land of the Beastly Brigands in the Whamite Isles. Badmuddin represented the Land of the Beastly Brigands in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Lady Azana Winter was the lord of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR, and a descendent of the previous Lady Tessaril Winter.
Babadul was a dao fugitive inhabiting the Great Dismal Delve on the Elemental Plane of Earth in 1367 DR.
Azena'ar was a drider who operated the Underdark Arena for House Cay'Vorym in the 1480s DR.
Azerie Germond was a cleric of Amaunator in the Cormyrean town of Eveningstar in the late 15 century DR.
Aylbart was a male elf that lived in the Kingdom of Mertwig around the 14 century DR.
Aya Ironhart was a dwarven cleric of Amaunator and adventurer in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Azmagol was a Shadovar wizard of Returned Netheril who pursued the Abyssal Planus Mechanus Nether Scroll in the late 15 century DR.

Badger Bates was a dwarf laborer in Sembia during the 13 and 14 centuries DR, who'd seen Malaeragoth during his razing of Uvalkhur's manor, avenging the wizard against his rivals; he was quite obsessive about that.

Awadabh was a pasha in the city of Calimport, Calimshan, in the late 14 century DR. Awadabh's high-class villa lay in Mabul Drudach, Otahl Sabban, in the city's Emerald Ward and comprised multiple three- and four-story buildings.
Baerend "Blackblade" Blakshar was a Highknight of Cormyr's Purple Dragons in the 13 century DR.

Backtalk was a hobgoblin in the Lostafinga tribe, who served under Lieutenant Julla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Backtalk wasn't his true name, but rather a nickname he had received as a veteran of the troop from sergeants Cheff and Smut.
Aznar Thrul, Zulkir of Evocation and Tharchion of the Priador, was one of the eight rulers of Thay and its Red Wizards.
Azoun Obarskyr II () was a king of Cormyr. He was thin and lean in appearance.
Baklin was a dwarf of Clan Stoneshaft who lived in Waterdeep during the late 14 century DR.
Barandos Hawklin was the popular head of the Hawklin noble family in Suzail in 1368 DR.
A balhiir was a magic-absorbing creature from the negative Energy plane.
Bareris Anskuld was a Mulan human bard of Thay in the late 14 century DR. During the War of the Zulkirs, he was transformed into an undead being.
Bangor Battlehammer was the father of the more famous Bruenor Battlehammer, king of Mithral Hall.
Barglun Blackbutter was the founder of the Blackbutter Inn in Red Larch.
Bardag Shultu is the hostler and stablemaster of The Old Skull Inn in Shadowdale.
High Priest Barriltar Bhandraddon was a cleric of Torm and high priest of the Temple of Torm's Coming in Tantras in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Baniya Dolester was a human female priestess of Lliira in the city of Procampur in the Vast.
Commander Balacer Macefist was a human officer in charge of the Golden Fortress Military Academy in Eshpurta, Amn, circa the .
Barrowin Undurr was a devoted dwarf cleric of Gorm Gulthyn. Along with several other adventurers, she played a vital role in thwarting the schemes of the Cult of the Dragon in the late 15 century DR.

Barroch was said to be the first great bandit lord of the Inner Sea lands. He made his lair at Barroch's Hold, a fabled citadel in the Glacier of the White Worm. In the Year of the Worm, 1356 DR, a band of adventurers rediscovered Barroch's Hold in the Glacier of the White Worm. However, they soon ran into a number of strange creatures, and were separated or killed.

Senior Fury Barasta Cleeith was a wealthy noblewoman of House Lurraxol who lived in Athkatla during the mid–14 century DR She a high-ranking Waukeenar priestess at Goldenspires as well as a member of the Knights of the Shield as of the .
Bani Matruj al-Haddar, or the Silent Sheikh, was a goblin barber living in Liham in 1367 DR.

Barander "The Tortured King" was the 46th Obarskyr monarch and a king of Cormyr. He was a grandnephew of Gorauna. After a year of reigning, he abdicated the throne to his cousin Thargreve, who would go on to become Thargreve the Greater.
Bara Minora was a halfling who worked and cared for Hama Sayif within the Grand Bazaar of Huzuz in 1367 DR.
Baltir Merivolst was the most famous commander of the Knights of the Flying Hunt in 1374 DR.
Balt Greenbrow was the main agent of the Tall Trees druidic order.
Baran al-Amin al-Jinn was a janni who lived in Al-Yabki Mountains in Zakhara in 1367 DR.
Bando the Lame was an old halfling priest of Tymora in Daggerford around 1370 DR.
Barimus Whitehand was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl, i.e., from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR.
Baralea Braceryn was part-owner, cook, and hostess at the Three Elves inn in Voonlar circa the Year of Wild Magic, 1372 DR. __NOTOC__
Baric Nylef was a knight of Tyr that lived in Bryn Shander some time after the War of the Silver Marches.
Bapar Ghalmrin was a member of Clan Ghalmrin in the Starspire Mountains in Tethyr in 1370 DR.
Barger was a bald clerk and member of the town watch in Nesmé in 1484 DR.
Barak al-Gani was a merchant who frequently visited the ruins of Ysawis in east Zakhara in 1367 DR.
Barim Stagwinter was one of the rulers of Boareskyr Bridge in 1359 DR.
Barrom Quiverleaf was a half-elf wizard who restlessly searched for a mysterious woman.
Bann Alagondar was a member of the Alagondar royal family and the king of Neverwinter in the late years of the 14th century DR.

Baratathlaer, also called Tayyib-kher, was a male ancient brass dragon who made its lair somewhere in the Scimitar Spires in Anauroch. He was known to be still alive by 1373 DR. The Bedine consider him to be a good-natured protector of the Scimitar Spires and he has been known to hold-up an entire tribe's travel by engaging in long conversations with their elders.
Baragh was a battle-hardened drow patron of the Ust Natha tavern who shared tales with his patrons, around 1369 DR
Barach Hilthone was a servant of Gond during the mid–14 century DR.

Barachiel (), the Messenger, was a member of the Celestial Hebdomad and ruler of Lunia, the Silver Heaven of Mount Celestia. His symbol was the lion. He was also the herald of the Hebdomad, the leader of Celestia's defenses, the leader of the trumpet archons, and a patron of mortal heralds.

Bannaeras Thaelok was the operator of Thaelok's Fine Leathers, a tannery operating out of a small bay south of the main harbor of Port Llast, in the late 15 century DR. Aside from his main occupation, Thaelok also farmed squid and octopuses.
Bariaurs were quadrupedal natives of the Upper Planes, primarily the plane of Ysgard and the House of Nature.
Baphitaurs were monstrous planetouched creatures that lived in the Labyrinth in the Underdark.
Bardanther Uleeyon was a member of the War Wizards of Cormyr in the early 13 century DR. He was a former warrior that discovered he had an aptitude for the Art in his later years.

Bargrivyek was the goblinoid deity of unity and cooperation, titled Peacekeeper for his role of encouraging teamwork between the various goblinoid races and tribes. However, he was also a god of territory, and his peacekeeping role did not extend to creating positive relations between goblinoids and other races.
Barcus Wroot was a deep gnome who lived in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Sarth Baretha was a githyanki warrior who was alive during the late 15 century DR.
Barrow was a male human burglar active in Daggerford circa 1372 DR.
Balen was a bodyguard who served in the employ of Lord Farnig Seasilver of Marsember during the late 15 century DR.
Barlos was one of ten guards stationed at the enclave run by the young Red Wizard Hinnar.
Balarystul was a spy of Bahamut who posed as a Calishite barber named Burney inside the Wandering Emporium, which traveled across the plains of Avernus in the Nine Hells in the late 15 century DR.
Balt was the general and the consort of the Batiri goblin queen M'bobo in the mid-14 century DR.
Balathel was a priest of Helm and member of Sir Justin Melenikus's watchers at Iniarv's Tower in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bannoc, son of Enroc, was a cleric of Tyr and a venerated of Myth Drannor who died before the city's destruction in the Weeping War of 714 DR.
Barienne was a young lady that lived in Scornubel during the mid–14 century DR.
Baralen the Black was an infamous pirate who once kidnapped the daughter of Lord Tygarian.
Barr-Find was a half-orc bard and proxy of the Celtic power known as Manannan Mac Lir.
Banderlogs were intelligent primates that resembled green-skinned baboons with brown fur.
Balaera Chrintavimn was a warrior and sage inhabiting Yhaunn in 1358 DR.
Bandik was the villagemaster of the guilders in the Garden of the Cursed. He was bamboozled by the charlatan Trifakas, thus leading the guilders to do his bidding.
Baltron Quillfeather was a scholar and a member of the Harpers based at Twilight Hall in the city of Berdusk in the Western Heartlands in the late 14 century DR.
Balpor was a Shadovar soldier and scout in a reconnaissance unit that served Prince Escanor Tanthul of Thultanthar during the late 14 century DR.
Balanta Whiteshield was a skilled warrior and follower of Lurue during the mid–14 century DR.
Barrodar was a successful merchant and shopkeeper inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.
Bannor Karralo was a barkeep inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Balaghast Brightlingar was an innkeep inhabiting the city of Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Ban Fuka was a salesman in the town of Bralizzar who specialized in grain. They were known to be active in the mid-14 century DR. Their shop was the northmost one on the western side of the bazaar.

Balmeric was the leader of the soldiers guarding adventuress Zaranda Star's merchant caravan as she traveled from Morninggold Keep to Zazesspur in Mirtul of 1366 DR. He afterward became Highstar over the Warriors of the Star.
Barlo Rageblade was an adventurer who lived in the Realms during the late 15 century DR.

Barrit was a scholar and wizard who lived in Tilverton circa 1369 DR. He performed research for the Puppetmasters adventuring company, and located Barrenstone for them, the lost underground home of Adzerak the lich. His home was two buildings north-west of the Whispering Witch inn, and he was good friends with the ruling Rowanmantle family.

Lord Barrit Cormaeril was a member of the noble Cormaeril family of Cormyr in the 14 century DR. In the , Lord Barrit attended King Azoun Obarskyr IV's birthday feast, hosted by Lord Partic Thistle at Thistleflame Keep. He was accompanied there by Lady Alise Cormaeril.
Ballaera Heerilyte, who was nicknamed Tentacles by some, was a wizard inhabiting Suldolphor in the far eastern reaches of Calimshan in south Faerûn during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Baret was a young man of Yhaunn who joined the temple of Shar in the late 14 century DR.
Barefoot Holtman was an older human male that lived in the Kingdom of Mertwig around the 14 century DR.
Bardolan was an Amnian soldier and guard who served in Nashkel during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Balgor was a gold dwarf from the Rivington district of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Barnabus was the name given to a gnoll archer who was mentally enslaved by a follower of the Absolute in the Moonrise Towers during the late 15 century DR.
Barnie Pins was a faithless inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Ballarini was a Netherese arcanist who taught at the Inventor's Conservatory in the enclave of Eileanar until its destruction in .
Bargus Freely was an inhabitant of the city of Baldur's Gate who died some years before the late 15 century DR.
Baldemar Thurlow was the Speaker of Lonelywood of the Ten Towns in the late 13 century DR.
Barandror Murandrake was a nobleman of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Barana Talmere was a cleric of Amaunator from the town of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Barnal Wulf was a human resident of Eveningstar in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Barmar Trull was a human magistrate of Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Balbaste Avithoul was the matron mother of House Avithoul during the Sschindylryn invasion of Eveningstar and the hunt for the Thread of the Weave in the 1480s DR.
The Baron of the Boreal Ball was a minor noble of the Feywild.
Barent was a human wizard who served as part of the paladin Gabriel's retinue.
Bantu was a human pirate sailing the Sea of Fallen Stars sometime in the mid–14 century DR.

Baldryn Irontooth was a trader from Clan Firehammer, formerly Clan Battlehammer, who did business with the Ten Towns on the behalf of Queen Gimla Firehammer's dwarven crafters and metallurgists the late 14 century DR.
Banister Avithoul was a drow House Avithoul slavemaster of Sschindylryn during the 1480s DR.
Baldric Goodhand was a cleric who did not worship any deities, committing his skills to an adventuring band called the Fallbacks in the late 15 and the turn of the 16 centuries DR.
Baroness Dulgrath was a noblewoman of Aglarond and an amateur yet talented vintner in the late 14 century DR.
Barney was an Azuthan priest, who later retired from the clergy to operate the Grand Griffon Inn, in the city of Ravens Bluff in the 14 century DR.
Balquo was a hunting companion of Aldeth Sashenstar, a patriar of the Baldurian Sashenstar family in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Barduk was a dwarf smith and mother of four who ran the business Barduk's Smithy with her children on the Rock of Bral in the 14 century DR.
Baram was one of the five High Captains of the city of Luskan. Along with the others he was an experienced adventurer and a former pirate.
Prior Bamaal Dunster () was one of several church leaders at the Spires of the Morning temple who worked under High Radiance Ghentilara.
Balthorr "the Bold" Olaskos was a fence and trader in Waterdeep who specialized primarily in currency, coins, and various rare trinkets during the mid-to-late 14th century DR.
Barjin was a powerful cleric of Talona in the mid–14 century DR.
Baskor Tranth was a surly wizard who dwelt in Suzail, frequenting its bars and taverns.
Beaugrat was a barbarian and a member of the Peacekeepers and the Order of Blue Flame.

Bebiliths, () otherwise known as barbed horrors or creepers of the Abyss, were massive demons that resembled arachnids. They roamed various layers of the Abyss and predated on whatever creatures they found- tanar'ri by preference but any living being by habit. While apparently intelligent, bebiliths did not communicate with anything save, perhaps, each other.
Bearface Giltch was a member of the Rocktappers of the Earthfast Mountains in the Vast and Impiltur, a band of prospectors and fur trappers who worked the mountains.
Beguld Thormon was a merchant who lived in Crimmor in Amn in the 14th century DR.

Bedon was a human cleric and monk of Ilmater and the leader of the Monastery of St. Fanal in the Alimir Mountains circa 1374 DR. Brother Bedon instated a policy that no one who came to the monastery seeking knowledge could be denied. However, he made a special effort to assist all visitors that were dedicated to peace and goodness. He saw his role at the monastery, dedicated to the preservation and teaching of history, as a means to quell strife around Calimshan and the Lake of Steam.
Beartrid Winters was the wife of Kalas Winters, who owned the Wolf's Pelt Inn in the Icewind Dale community of Targos.
Bassilus, or Bassilus the Murderer, was a male human priest of Cyric who wandered around Beregost.

Basad yn Malik el Ostak was the leader of el Kahmir clan in Memnon in 1370 DR, chosen by that family to oversee the assassins', thieves', smugglers', and slavers' guilds there. He was young at the time and loyal to the syl-pasha.

Beealtimatuche was a pit fiend servant of Asmodeus. Beealtimatuche was summoned in 1462 DR by the lich Valindra Shadowmantle in Gauntlgrym to fight Drizzt Do'Urden and Bruenor Battlehammer. Bruenor lost his life while destroying the pit fiend.
Pasha Basadoni was the leader of House Basadoni, one of the more powerful thieves' guilds in Calimport in Calimshan in the mid–14 century DR.
Basel Indoulur was the governor of Halagard in Halruaa in 1367 DR.
Barunga Foestone was a frost giant in the late 15th century DR.
Batina al-Shaat was a moralist priest of Hajama and the leader of the Preachers in 1367 DR.
Basil Grem was a musician in Elventree during the late 1480s DR.
Batu Min Ho was a general first in the army of Shou Lung and later in the Grand Army of the Tuigan.
Bashenee was a githzerai craftsman of magic items active during a past age and in a realm beyond the Astral Plane.
Bassorah was an inhabitant of Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.
Basem bin Rumi was a gnome alchemist and researcher living in Huzuz, the City of Delights, in 1367 DR.

Behring was an unusual dwarf wizard in Daggerford around 1370 DR. Alustriel of Silverymoon believed he had human blood despite Behring denying this hypothesis. He liked the open spaces of the wilderness and did not love the underground locales typical of his fellows. His home was located in the northwest corner of Daggerford along Wall Street.
Barry A. A. Dillinger is a horror novelist who has contributed to Dragon. He has also acted as a television and movie screenwriter.
Bastabar Yulgont was a cleric of Cyric with the rank of Dark Hand who resided in the Dark God Reformed temple in Voonlar circa the Year of Wild Magic, 1372 DR.
Basil Arness was a high-ranking officer of Muktar in the Turmish in 1358 DR.
Barthelby was a high-ranking priest of Jergal in Undermountain in 1479 DR.
Barzan al-Hiyali served as captain-general of Krak al-Niraan in 1367 DR.
Bazamarl was the leader of a cell of the Cult of Reborn Flame that operated out of Sambral, one of the Windrise Ports of Laerakond, in 1479 DR.
The Beguiler was a species of exceptionally intelligent, non-aggressive mouse-like creature that possessed several astounding qualities.
Belabra, also known as tanglers, were solitary creatures that inhabited temperate forests of Faerûn.
Bedlen Daglefodd was a humble svirfneblin who lived in a small village in the Underdark.
Basillus was a cleric of Cyric who went mad after his family died.
Barton was an innkeeper who lived in the Ten Towns during the late 15 century DR. He was the proprietor of the Hooked Knucklehead inn within the walled town of Bryn Shander.
Bartholomew Tidfigit was the owner of The Royal Arms Inn in Luskan in the mid–14 century DR.
Barth was a swordsman that hailed from the Western Heartlands in the late 15 century DR.
Becil Boareskyr and his brother Bullard Boareskyr were dimwitted descendants of the legendary hero Boareskyr.
Lord Bartan Helfer was a human aristocrat of Phsant in Thesk in the mid–14 century DR. Around 1372 DR, he was the leader of the ruling Merchants' Council, as the title First Council Lord.
Bel Dalemark was a merchant who lived in the city of Athkatla in the mid–14 century DR. He was known to deal in commodities and basic armaments.
The Beggar Caliph was a mysterious beggar inhabiting Hiyal around 1367 DR.
Beherant Diir was one of a group merchants who sold their wares in the town of Imnesvale during the mid–14 century DR.
Bazelsteen was a cornugon harbormaster in Avernus, first layer of the Nine Hells, in the late 15 century DR.
Beatrice was a noblewoman of Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Bawr was a pirate captain of the Narwhal and a member of the Refuge Bay Trading Company who traveled between Baldur's Gate and Chult circa 1362 DR.

Beasts of Xvim were creatures, predominantly carnivorous monsters and animals, that had been warped by the malevolent will of the dark god Iyachtu Xvim into soul-devouring harbingers of fear and violence.

Barus Broadblade was the leader of the guards for the slaver ring hidden in the Oasis of the White Palm. Shortly after the release of Khalitharius, during , he had been captured by the dervish cultists of the oasis for interrogation.
Baylox, the Master Mage of Shussel, was a skilled wizard and sage and frequent visitor of the small town of Azun in Okoth in the .
Bartholeme Guin was an adventurer and a member of the Company of the Lynx for a time during the mid–14 century DR.
Baskar Lendo was a sage who lived in the village of Eveningstar during the late 14 century DR.
Beherit was an archdevil, the original Lord of Malbolge, the sixth layer of the Nine Hells.
Bartimus was the House mage of the noble merchant Talricci family of Arrabar in the Vilhon Reach in the late 14 century DR.
Bastinado was a ranger, adventurer, and a member of the Annals of Halgren in the early 14 century DR.
Batu, who was nicknamed the Lame, was a civilized nomad who lived in Almorel on the Lake of Mists in the Hordelands in the .
Beb-Shuur, along with his esteemed colleague Xianga, was a member of the short-lived Order of Theorosophers, active in the late 14 century DR.
Bavlorna Blightstraw (), also known as Slack-jawed Lorna, was one of the three hags of the Hourglass Coven, that took control of Prismeer, one of the Domains of Delight of the Feywild.
Becket and Tram were a pair of twin fighters who adventured with the Stag Runners company circa 1369 DR.
Bel Morgahl was a captain of the Neverwinter Guard who served her city during the late 15 century DR. She led the guards stationed at one of the city's districts other than Blacklake.
Ambassador Belakira was a Red Wizard and the political representative of the nation of Thay in the city of Ravens Bluff in the late 14 century DR.
Bartek Alforael was an adventurer in Cormyr with the Warhawks company in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Belair was a Netherese arcanist who taught at the Inventor's Conservatory in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Bartolommeo was a Netherese arcanist who worked as a herbalist in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Bathtar Flamegallow was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Bearclaw was an unsavory barbarian gnome mercenary from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Beaufort was a Netherese priest who worked at the Mythomian Warehouse in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Barundryn Harbright was an explorer in the mid–8 century DR.
Barthold Moncrief was one of the Magistrates of Cormyr, who performed work in the towns of Eveningstar and Wheloon in the late 15 century DR.
Battrick Degronce was an inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Beckla Shadesar was a human wizard of Waterdeep in the early 14 century DR.

Bayle Carrathal was a High King of Callidyrr in the early-to-mid–11 century DR. Like his predecessors, although he held the title of High King of the Moonshae Isles, he was considered to be merely a figurehead by the Ffolk outside of Callidyrr.
Bedi was a half-orc barbarian worshiper of the Absolute and a guide, stationed in the Moonrise Towers during the late 15 century DR.
Batu Hsuang Wu was the headstrong, intelligent and independent daughter of Hsuang Yu Po and wife to Batu Min Ho
Beastmen were humanoids creatures roughly similarly to short and slender humans, but covered in a green-coloured fur.
Bastian d'Zinn was a human member of the upper class that inhabited the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Begg was a captain of the guard in Zazesspur, Tethyr, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Beccard Rellock was a caravaneer somewhere in the Savage Frontier.
Baxa Morgan was a vengeful human bard miscreant who held a grudge against certain officials of Mossbridges and Ravens Bluff in the Vast, active in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
The so-called Batiri Runt was a weakling Batiri goblin who chose to be an adventurer and a jungle guide after being exiled from his home tribe in the late 15 century DR.

Barsik was a house cat and a self-proclaimed cleric who dedicated himself to the worship of Sharess, the Mother of Cats, the Feline of Felicity, from the streets of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
